ModMetaData.name: RimOPT
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Focused synchronous work-search optimization extracted from measured RimMT modules. RimOPT reduces invalid DoBill, HaulMerge, roof, harvest, and snow candidates, and adds bounded Work search tail planning inside one package. It does not patch ticking, thread ownership, path results, reservations, or Job results.
